summary: Batch fresh-store schema installation to reduce durable sync waits before the daemon serves requests

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection rules change.

schema.detail: The same tables, indexes, triggers and schema version are installed. Only fresh-store transaction boundaries change.

rules.detail: Identity, signing, admission, startup readiness and request deadlines are unchanged. WAL and synchronous=FULL remain in use.

compatibility.detail: Only a database with no user schema objects at opening entry batches core and initial runtime DDL. Populated stores retain per-statement installation, including completed upgrade indexes. Independent migrations and backfills retain their boundaries.

downtime.detail: Fresh-store startup performs fewer durable commits before binding listeners. Existing stores receive no sync reduction; no wait bound is increased and no retry is added.

recovery.detail: A failed or crashed fresh-install chunk rolls back its new objects and preserves data. Existing incomplete stores retain completed schema statements so an interrupted upgrade resumes its progress.
